T33.note: counting basis differs from T32 (no recovered T33 C): of the vendor tx-isp-t33.ko (1571 functions) 1162 have a T32 namesake and run on the shared driver/t32 port; the bar counts the 409 T33-only functions; proven = 308 that pass the binary oracle (vendor instructions in Unicorn against our C, tests/t33_binoracle, openimp #99); 5 more are ported by name in the T33 files but not oracle-proven yet (QEMU apitest only); 62 are unreachable (no caller and no function-pointer reference in the vendor module, or only from such code: nothing to prove); the remaining 39 are reachable (tuning node, /proc, irq, AOV) and not proven, see openimp #589, #590, #524; in addition 50 T32-namesake functions (CCM/CSC/CSCCR/BCSH/CLM/TMO/MDNS init, deinit, ev update, irq, api set/get, interpolation, size/stat helpers; open-tx-isp tests/t33_binoracle blocks cscP..mdnsQ and bcshN/O/H, tmoR, mdnsR, 2026-11-15) are proven against the T33 binary too: they are not in the bar (it counts T33-only functions) and not wired; not device-tested

T32.note: bit-exact against the recovered vendor C on the host; merged into open-tx-isp next; reference-C oracles stay on the T32 branch until upstream PR #15; host-proven, not device-tested

T10.note: T10 = driver/t10 wrappers + shared driver/t20 sources + Ingenic SDK; machine-like part = recovered Apical firmware unit driver/t20/tx_isp_t20_firmware.c (shared with T20); batches 1-18, Fable round 3 and the f4 struct-field batch (38 functions, vendor mutation fuzz) and the h1 round (last 12 machine-like FSM functions, identical objects) merged (system_tab, FSM family, ISP context layout, small helpers, API handlers, math, sensor-bus callbacks, crop/scaler FSM), host oracles + vendor vdiff/fuzz + T10 cam stream proof per batch

T20.note: shares the recovered firmware unit with T10 (open-tx-isp batches 1-18 + Fable round 3, f4 struct-field batch, h1 last 12 FSM functions: sensor-bus callbacks, crop/scaler FSM); inventory
